description: Picker-friendly scaffold for the 8th-generation gas Camry (XV70, 2018-2024). 2.5L A25A-FKS or 3.5L 2GR-FKS V6 engine, 8-speed automatic, TNGA-K platform. Note: the 9th-generation Camry (2025+) is hybrid-only; use `toyota-camry-hybrid-2018plus` for those. No manufacturer-specific PIDs are shipped — the value-add is vehicle_match metadata + transmission ECU declaration for future sweeps. Standard Mode 01 PIDs auto-discovered by the app cover RPM, MAF, fuel trims, throttle, coolant/intake temps, O2 sensors, catalyst temps, etc. The single `rpm` entry below is a placeholder to satisfy the iOS importer's non-empty-pids requirement and is a redeclaration of the standard Mode 01 PID 0C (the sampler dedupes by (mode, pid) so this is a no-op against auto-discovery).
sources: Standard SAE J1979 Mode 01 PIDs — auto-discovered, not enumerated here

validated_against.notes: Scaffolded for an upcoming rental trip. No custom PIDs authored. Same rationale as toyota-rav4-2019plus: scaffold provides picker UX + transmission ECU declaration for sweep targeting. The TNGA-K platform shares the same diagnostic-bus layout as the RAV4 (7E0 engine / 7E1 transmission), so a sweep methodology developed against one vehicle should port to the other.
